title: Distributed Eval Farm Coordinator
tagline: Partition cases, lease shards and aggregate bounded concurrent workers.
summary: Build the coordinator logic behind an evaluation farm: deterministic partitions, fenced leases, idempotent results and a real bounded goroutine worker pool. The reference deployment runs in one process; network transport and cross-process storage are explicit extension points.
usefulFor: Partition cases, lease shards and aggregate bounded concurrent workers.
Offline experiments with explicit failure cases and limits
youWillBuild: Build the coordinator logic behind an evaluation farm: deterministic partitions, fenced leases, idempotent results and a real bounded goroutine worker pool. The reference deployment runs in one process; network transport and cross-process storage are explicit extension points.
skills: Run a bounded local worker pool

stages.title: Partition stable case identities
stages.summary: Assign each nonempty unique case ID to one of a positive number of shards using FNV-1a.

stages.title: Fence each shard lease
stages.summary: A coordinator owns a lease record.

stages.title: Accept idempotent completion receipts
stages.summary: A completion carries shard owner, lease version and a nonempty result.

stages.title: Run a bounded local worker pool
stages.summary: Start at most the configured number of goroutines, dispatch each unique ID once and collect results in stable ID order.
